notes: 1.0.8: Them bao cao tien do len Telegram. Nut moi 'Telegram' o goc phai tren: bat/tat, bot token, chat ID, so phut moi lan bao. Tool tu gui 3 loai tin: BAT DAU (loai viec, model, tong so viec, so luong, thu muc ra), TIEN DO dinh ky (thanh tien do, OK/Loi/Dung, da chay, con khoang bao lau, giay/viec), KET THUC (tong ket + duong dan thu muc ra). Bam DUNG cung gui tin bao. De trong o token thi tool tu lay TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN trong .env cua Hermes. Token duoc che khi ghi log. Them tests/test_tele.py (26 test) va tests/test_tele_gui.py (9 test chay GUI that voi may chu gia).
